D01.quote: It has an SVG only, with no `aria-label`, a 28x28px target and a 1px #ccc border.

D05.quote: Neither the logo nor the hero image has `alt`.

D06.quote: The cells are empty red and green blocks with no text or icon.

D07.quote: `tabindex="3"` on FAQ. Measured tab sequence is FAQ, Pricing, Sign in.

D08.quote: The plan names are `<h4>` straight after `<h1>` (L77, 85, 91)

D09.quote: Reduced motion is ignored (verified: animation is still `scroll`).

D12.quote: Input border #e6e6e6 (L44) is about 1.3:1 against white, against a 3:1 target.

D14.quote: Footer links are about 14px tall with 6px gaps (below the 24px WCAG 2.2 minimum)

D15.quote: It is `width:180px; overflow:hidden; nowrap`, with scrollWidth 357 against clientWidth 180.

D17.quote: Paddings are 20, 24 and 28px, and heights are 267, 237 and 438px.

D19.quote: `max-width:none` gives a 1232px measure of about 190 characters per line, with `line-height:1`.

D20.quote: Five unrelated font stacks.** Georgia, Arial, Comic Sans (banner, L14), Courier (ticker and prices, L16, 33) and Impact

D21.quote: All three plan CTAs read "Click here" (L82, 88, 94).**

D22.quote: Static errors show on load: a raw "Error 422" plus a redundant "invalid email address".

D23.quote: The errors have no `aria-describedby`, `role="alert"` or `aria-invalid`, and give no recovery hint.

D25.quote: Buttons are a generic "OK" / "Cancel", with no danger styling and OK first.

D28.quote: Rocket, lock and chart emoji are not hidden from assistive tech and render differently per OS.

D31.quote: No landmarks or skip link.** There is no `<nav>` or `<main>`

unlisted.quote: There is no `<form>` element, so Enter does nothing.
unlisted.why: Newsletter input and button are not inside a form element.

unlisted.quote: `role=dialog` is inline and not modal, with no focus management or Escape handling.
unlisted.why: Static div with role=dialog, no modal behaviour or script.

unlisted.quote: A workspace-deletion prompt makes no sense on a pricing page.
unlisted.why: Delete-workspace dialog is out of place on the pricing page.

unlisted.quote: `.hero .lede` on the violet gradient (L22) is 4.04:1 at 18px.

unlisted.why: Price divs show no unit; only the faint lede mentions monthly.

unlisted.quote: "Most popular tier" sits on the cheapest tier (Starter).
unlisted.why: Badge is on the Starter card at line 78.

unlisted.quote: Yellow `.btn-primary` and purple `.choose` have the same weight, and no plan is clearly recommended.
unlisted.why: Two competing button styles and no emphasised plan.

unlisted.quote: `:root` tokens exist but components use raw hex.
unlisted.why: Components use raw hex, with tokens defined but barely used.

unlisted.quote: The links at L62-64 and the footer links are `href="#"` placeholders.
unlisted.why: Sign in and footer links are href=# and nav has no current state.
Table lacks caption and scope attributes.

unlisted.quote: The logo isn't a link home
unlisted.why: Logo img is not wrapped in a link.

unlisted.quote: Banner, ticker and hero take about 410px at 1280px, so the plans start about 730px down.
unlisted.why: Stacked banner, ticker and hero push plans below the fold.

unlisted.quote: Their content spills past the card borders
unlisted.why: No-wrap flex row at 375px squeezes cards and content overflows.
